verdict.rationale: Cursor's official docs describe first-class MCP support: connecting external tools/data sources, installing servers via a marketplace with OAuth, configuring custom servers via JSON, enterprise admin controls, toggling servers, and approval prompts before tool use — directly matching the story of plugging in MCP servers so the product can use their tools. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community corroboration specifically validating MCP tool usage in practice.
